query:
SELECT 'relation' AS kind,c.relname AS object_name,c.relkind::text AS object_type FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='fleet_private'
UNION ALL SELECT 'type',t.typname,t.typtype::text FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='fleet_private'
UNION ALL SELECT 'routine',p.proname,p.prokind::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='fleet_private'
UNION ALL SELECT 'schema_acl',n.nspname,n.nspacl::text FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname='fleet_private'
ORDER BY kind,object_name
